Executive Assistant to the Tumuaki - CLOSED

Ōtaki Campus
1.0  FTE Full time, Fixed Term (6 months with potential to extend)
9am – 5pm

Are you after a dynamic role within a kaupapa Māori environment with opportunity to advance your career? A special and unique place of learning, Te Wānanga o Raukawa is a tikanga Māori tertiary education provider. A vacancy has arisen for an Executive Assistant extraordinaire to join Te Whare o Te Tumuaki full time covering maternity leave at our main campus located in Ōtaki.


The successful applicant will be required to perform a variety of administrative tasks and provide support to the tumuaki, Dr Mereana Selby.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to managing calendars, emails, minute taking, preparing travel arrangements and drafting or preparing relevant documentation and publications as required. Successful applicants should have a sound knowledge of the guiding kaupapa of Te Wānanga o Raukawa, be highly organised, have time management skills, be able to take initiative, and have competency of te reo Māori. 


Applications close: Friday 17 March 2024


For a full job description, or to apply contact:

Dionne Seng, Kaihautū Te Whare Tiaki Rawa

Īmēra: dionne.seng@twor-otaki.ac.nz

Waea: 06 3649011 extn 757
